image.subject: Edmond Dantès, a lean dark-haired young sailor in a plain sailor's linen shirt and dark trousers, wades ashore from a small boat onto a bare rocky Mediterranean island at dusk, grey sea behind him

storyboard.claim: Dantès reaches the bare island of Monte Cristo.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A lone sailor steps from a boat onto barren rock at dusk.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Continues the escape and sea journey after the burial sack.
storyboard.addedInformation: The island is a bare, remote rock in the Mediterranean.

image.subject: Edmond Dantès, a lean dark-haired young sailor in a plain sailor's linen shirt, kneels on a barren rocky shore studying a folded paper map, a small creek of water beside him

storyboard.claim: Dantès uses Faria's map to find the treasure spot.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A sailor kneels over a paper map beside a small creek.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Follows the arrival on the island.
storyboard.addedInformation: The map was Faria's, left from the prison.

image.subject: Edmond Dantès, a lean dark-haired young sailor, heaves a large boulder aside on bare rocky ground, a dark cavern mouth opening in the hillside beneath him

storyboard.claim: He counts paces, lifts the twentieth rock and enters a cavern.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A sailor strains to shift a boulder that reveals a dark cave mouth.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Follows the map walk.
storyboard.addedInformation: He is physically strong after years in prison.

image.subject: a hidden Mediterranean grotto lit by a single flaring torch, faceted granite walls glittering blue in the flickering light, a dark sea-cave with a damp stone floor

storyboard.claim: The cavern walls sparkle in torchlight.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Faceted granite walls catch torchlight in a dark sea cave.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Dantès has just entered the cavern.
storyboard.addedInformation: The grotto is a natural sea cave, not a built room.

image.subject: a rusted iron-bound wooden chest broken open on a cave floor, the lid flung back, heaped old gold coins spilling out in torchlight

storyboard.claim: He breaks open the rusted chest and finds treasure.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A broken iron-bound chest spills gold coins.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Dantès dug down to the chest.
storyboard.addedInformation: The chest is old, bound in rusted iron.

storyboard.claim: The hoard holds gold, diamonds, pearls and rubies.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A list of treasure types on text.
storyboard.onScreenText: GOLD COINS / SOLID INGOTS / DIAMONDS / PEARLS AND RUBIES
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Describes what the chest contains.
storyboard.addedInformation: The treasure is a mix of coin, bullion and gems.

image.subject: a dark cave floor piled high with gold ingots and loose diamonds spilling among pearls, torchlight glinting off the heap

storyboard.claim: The treasure is wealth beyond comprehension.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A heap of ingots and gems filling the cave floor.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Describes the chest's contents in full.
storyboard.addedInformation: The scale of the hoard is an entire economy.

image.subject: an old oak chest of tarnished gold coins standing on a cobbled Paris street in the 1830s, a horse-drawn carriage passing behind it

storyboard.claim: The old treasure now sits in a modern industrial era.
storyboard.concreteVisual: An old chest of gold set against a 1830s city street.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Turns from the hoard to the problem of using it.
storyboard.addedInformation: The setting is 1830s Paris, an industrial age of banks.

storyboard.claim: How can a sixteenth-century hoard be used in the 1830s?
storyboard.concreteVisual: A question on text about using old gold in modern banks.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Follows the image of the chest on a city street.
storyboard.addedInformation: You cannot simply withdraw gold from a bank.

image.subject: a Parisian private banking office in the 1830s, a mahogany counter, a plain wooden chest of gold coins set on the floor, bankers in dark suits watching in silence

storyboard.claim: A bank will not accept a chest of old gold without questions.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A banking office staring at a chest of gold on the floor.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Answers the question of using the gold.
storyboard.addedInformation: Banks of the period demanded legitimate provenance.

image.subject: a candlelit 1830s Parisian salon, gilt mirrors, velvet chairs, bankers and counts in evening dress talking in small groups

storyboard.claim: Wealth opens doors beyond simply buying objects.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A gilded Paris salon full of men in evening dress.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Follows the banking problem with what wealth can do.
storyboard.addedInformation: Money buys access to high society.

image.subject: a tall pale aristocrat in his thirties in a black frock coat and white silk cravat, dark hair swept back, cold piercing gaze, 1830s Paris gentleman, reading a ledger at a candlelit study desk

storyboard.claim: Wealth lets a man rewrite his own identity.
storyboard.concreteVisual: The Count reads a ledger at a desk by candlelight.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Explains what wealth does beyond buying things.
storyboard.addedInformation: The Count is a new persona built on the treasure.

image.subject: a loose handful of cut diamonds spread on a merchant's wooden counter in a Genoa counting house, a brass balance scale beside them, a bearded merchant's hand reaching in

storyboard.claim: He sells a few diamonds in Genoa to start his capital.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Diamonds on a merchant's counter beside a scale.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Starts the liquidation of the treasure.
storyboard.addedInformation: Selling in Genoa avoids drawing attention in Paris.

image.subject: a stack of shipping-firm debt papers on a Genoa counting-house desk, a cut diamond resting on top of them as a paperweight, candlelight

storyboard.claim: He buys shipping firms' debts with the diamond capital.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Debt papers on a desk weighed down by a diamond.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Uses the capital from the diamond sale.
storyboard.addedInformation: Buying debt gives him leverage over shipping houses.

image.subject: a Paris banker's walnut desk with bond certificates fanned across it, a brass inkwell and a sealed letter, a candle burning low

storyboard.claim: He builds credit lines across Europe's major banking houses.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Bond certificates fanned on a banker's desk.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Follows the debt purchases into wider finance.
storyboard.addedInformation: Treasure is converted into bonds and credit.

storyboard.claim: He turns a legend into arithmetic.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A quotation line on text: he turns myth into mathematics.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Summarises the conversion of treasure into finance.
storyboard.addedInformation: Untraceable liquidity gives him narrative control.

image.subject: a tall pale aristocrat in his thirties in a black frock coat and white silk cravat, dark hair swept back, cold piercing gaze, 1830s Paris gentleman, standing before a gilt mirror in a Paris dressing room, a folded sailor's linen shirt on a chair beside him

storyboard.claim: He has rebuilt his identity from the ground up.
storyboard.concreteVisual: The Count faces a mirror while a sailor's shirt lies discarded.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Explains the structural rewrite of identity.
storyboard.addedInformation: The old sailor's life is set aside completely.

image.subject: a sleek two-masted smuggling yacht at night on a Mediterranean sea, a dark-haired sailor in a sailor's linen shirt at the helm, a lantern glowing on the deck

storyboard.claim: He operates a second persona as Sinbad the sailor.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A smuggling yacht at night with a sailor at the helm.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: First of the personas listed.
storyboard.addedInformation: Sinbad runs smuggling networks at sea.

image.subject: a grave Italian abbé in a black cassock and white collar standing at the bedside of a sweating, guilt-ridden man in a Paris townhouse, a single candle on the table

storyboard.claim: Busoni, a wise priest, unsettles those with guilty consciences.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A priest at a bedside with a candle, the sick man in distress.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Second persona in the list.
storyboard.addedInformation: Busoni is a priest persona used to confront the guilty.

image.subject: a tall pale aristocrat in his thirties in a black frock coat and white silk cravat, dark hair swept back, cold piercing gaze, 1830s Paris gentleman, entering a candlelit Parisian salon, bankers and counts in evening dress turning to look

storyboard.claim: The Count is designed to infiltrate Parisian high society.
storyboard.concreteVisual: The Count enters a salon and every guest turns to look at him.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Final persona in the list.
storyboard.addedInformation: He is an icy aristocrat who blends into the elite.

image.subject: a vast underground palace of carved stone arches and gold lamps hollowed inside a Mediterranean island grotto, lit by hanging lanterns, empty and silent

storyboard.claim: He hollows out the island into a hidden palace.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A vast arched cavern lit by lanterns beneath an island.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Describes what he built with the treasure.
storyboard.addedInformation: The grotto is rebuilt as an Arabian-style palace.

image.subject: a tall pale aristocrat in his thirties in a black frock coat and white silk cravat, dark hair swept back, cold piercing gaze, 1830s Paris gentleman, standing unseen in the shadow of a dark doorway, watching a candlelit room

storyboard.claim: He watches everything and owes nothing to anyone.
storyboard.concreteVisual: The Count stands watching from a dark doorway.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Summarises his power over others.
storyboard.addedInformation: He is detached and unaccountable.

image.subject: Edmond Dantès, a lean dark-haired young sailor in a ragged prison shirt, gripping the iron bars of a damp stone cell on the Château d'If, a single barred window of grey light behind him

storyboard.claim: The reader sees how powerless he was before the treasure.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A ragged prisoner grips bars in a damp stone cell.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Contrasts the new persona with the old prisoner.
storyboard.addedInformation: He was held in the Château d'If for years.

storyboard.claim: He is a nineteenth-century Batman with unlimited resources.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A punchline on text comparing him to a superhero.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Joke that follows the triumphant reading of his story.
storyboard.addedInformation: He operates above the law.

image.subject: a tall pale aristocrat in his thirties in a black frock coat and white silk cravat, dark hair swept back, cold piercing gaze, 1830s Paris gentleman, stepping from shadow into a candlelit salon, bankers in evening dress recoiling

storyboard.claim: He uses theatre and deception to frighten corrupt men.
storyboard.concreteVisual: The Count steps from shadow and bankers draw back in alarm.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Explains the method behind the Batman comparison.
storyboard.addedInformation: His theatricality is a deliberate weapon.

storyboard.claim: The speaker challenges the reading of the superhero reinvention.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A question on text asking why to push back.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Turns from admiration to critique.
storyboard.addedInformation: The argument shifts to the Count's inner life.

image.subject: a tall pale aristocrat in his thirties in a black frock coat and white silk cravat, dark hair swept back, cold piercing gaze, 1830s Paris gentleman, standing alone at a tall shuttered window behind a gilded iron grille in a richly furnished townhouse

storyboard.claim: The Count may not be free despite his wealth.
storyboard.concreteVisual: The Count stands behind a gilded grille at a window.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Answers the critique with a question of freedom.
storyboard.addedInformation: A gilded grille suggests a cage.

image.subject: a gilded carnival-style mask lying on a candlelit velvet-covered table beside a pile of gold coins, a single white glove draped across the edge

storyboard.claim: He hides his humanity behind wealth and becomes its prisoner.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A gold mask on velvet beside coins.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Continues the freedom question with a visual of concealment.
storyboard.addedInformation: The mask is his public self, built from money.

storyboard.claim: Limitless wealth does not automatically make him free; look at his life.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Text-only statement challenging the view that wealth equals freedom.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Answers the freedom question directly.
storyboard.addedInformation: Attention moves to his daily habits.

image.subject: an empty, lavish Paris townhouse dining room, one gilded chair pulled back from a long set table, a tall window of grey dusk light and cold marble floors

storyboard.claim: Buying reality insulates a man from consequence and cuts him off from humanity.
storyboard.concreteVisual: An empty lavish dining room with one chair.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Explains how wealth cuts him off.
storyboard.addedInformation: Wealth isolates him from ordinary people.

image.subject: a tall pale aristocrat in his thirties in a black frock coat and white silk cravat, dark hair swept back, cold piercing gaze, 1830s Paris gentleman, seated at a long candlelit banquet table with a full plate of food untouched before him, guests in evening dress blurred behind

storyboard.claim: He barely eats at banquets, which makes him seem robotic and ghostly.
storyboard.concreteVisual: The Count sits before an untouched plate at a banquet.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Gives examples of his detachment.
storyboard.addedInformation: His refusal to eat marks him as eerie.

image.subject: a small dark glass bottle of tincture and a silver spoon on a bedside table beside a guttering candle in a shuttered Paris bedroom at night

storyboard.claim: He relies on a hashish concoction to sleep.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A tincture bottle and a spoon on a bedside table at night.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Continues the list of signs of his detachment.
storyboard.addedInformation: The drug is a nightly crutch for rest.

storyboard.claim: He says aloud that his heart is dead and he feels no pity, joy or fear.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A quotation line on text about feeling nothing.
storyboard.onScreenText: NO PITY, NO JOY, NO FEAR.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Gives his own words about his emptiness.
storyboard.addedInformation: He describes himself as emotionally empty.

image.subject: an ornate gilded birdcage standing empty on a white marble mantel of a Paris salon, its small door open, a single candle beside it

storyboard.claim: He has built a gilded cage and become an institution.
storyboard.concreteVisual: An empty gilded birdcage on a marble mantel.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Gives the metaphor for his self-made prison.
storyboard.addedInformation: He survived the dungeon and now waits for vengeance to mature.

image.subject: a pocket watch and an open leather ledger on a walnut desk in a 1830s banker's study, a candle burning down beside them, the room in shadow

storyboard.claim: He is a calculated banker of vengeance, not a superhero who protects people.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A pocket watch and ledger on a banker's desk by candlelight.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Recasts him as an investor rather than a hero.
storyboard.addedInformation: Revenge is treated as a long financial investment.

storyboard.claim: The label of investment banker of vengeance is dark and fitting.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A punchline on text naming him a banker of vengeance.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Reaction to the previous framing.
storyboard.addedInformation: The phrase sums up the calculated revenge.

image.subject: Marseille harbour at dawn, a three-masted merchant ship moored at the quay, fishing boats, stone warehouses along the waterfront, the low sun on the water

storyboard.claim: The audit of enemies begins at the bottom of the social ladder.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Marseille quayside at dawn with ships and warehouses.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Sets the start of the audit in Marseille.
storyboard.addedInformation: The story returns to the port where the betrayal began.

image.subject: a stooped middle-aged innkeeper in a stained brown waistcoat and loose shirt, unshaven, shifty eyes, counting coins behind a rough tavern counter in Marseille, 1815

storyboard.claim: Caderousse represents the rot of small greed.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Caderousse counts coins behind a tavern counter.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Introduces Caderousse as the baseline of the ledger.
storyboard.addedInformation: He is the small-scale betrayer, not a mastermind.

image.subject: three men drinking at a tavern table in Marseille: a stout middle-aged clerk in a dark suit and high white collar, a handsome dark-haired young Catalan fisherman in a faded blue jacket, and a stooped middle-aged innkeeper in a stained brown waistcoat, wine bottles on the table, 1815

storyboard.claim: Caderousse was a drinking companion of the two plotters at La Réserve.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Three men share a tavern table with wine bottles between them.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Places Caderousse among the conspirators.
storyboard.addedInformation: He was the tailor who drank with Danglars and Fernand.

image.subject: a stout middle-aged clerk in a dark suit and high white collar writing a letter at a tavern table by candlelight, a stooped innkeeper in a stained brown waistcoat watching nervously, an empty wine glass

storyboard.claim: Caderousse saw the letter being written and did nothing to stop it.
storyboard.concreteVisual: The clerk writes at a table while the innkeeper looks on.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Explains his complicity in the plot.
storyboard.addedInformation: He was too drunk and cowardly to intervene.
